assay: bulk RNA-seq, globin-depleted whole blood, strand-specific polyA, HiSeq 4000 (S2.3.p1)
sample_inclusion: 7 elite female speed skaters, day 18 of altitude camp (1850 m), whole blood before and after one intense skating bout; 14 samples, none excluded (S2.1.p1, S2.1.p2, S2.3.p1)
primary_estimand: Within-donor change in whole-blood gene expression after vs before an acute intense exercise bout at altitude (after - before)
planned_contrasts: after vs before exercise, paired by donor (FIG1, S3.2.p2; paper: 2516 up, 1542 down = 4058 DEGs at FDR<0.1)
normalization: DESeq2 size factors on RSEM per-gene counts (S2.5.p1); rlog + ComBat only for plots
paper_method: DESeq2 v1.18.1, design ~ donor + exercise, on RSEM gene-level counts (S2.5.p1, FIG1)
paper_results: 2516 up, 1542 down (S3.2.p2); 104 up / 58 down >2-fold; named genes MARC1, PHOSPHO1 up (S3.5.p5-6), MYC and TP53 down (S3.3.p2), PPBP platelet marker up (S3.5.p4)
